title: feat(spec,cli,lint): translate a form section entry's label, placeholder and helpText from _sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD
body:
Fixes #25459

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## What

A form section entry (`{ field, label, placeholder, helpText }` in a form view's `sections[].fields`) overrides the object field's copy for that form. A translation pack had no key for those three strings, and `translateView` never read `config.sections[].fields[]`, so a public form's entry overrides stayed in the authoring language beside translated headings and field labels.

The address, kept to the one `_sections` convention:

```
objects.OBJECT._sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD.label
objects.OBJECT._sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD.placeholder
objects.OBJECT._sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD.helpText
```

`SECTION` is the section's `name` and `FIELD` the entry's own `field`.

## Landing (as the PM measured, confirmed)

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: `_sections.SECTION` gains a strict `fields` record of `{ label, placeholder, helpText }` (`help` / `hint` / `tooltip` are refused with the rename to `helpText`; `entries` is refused with the rename to `fields`).
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`: `translateFormSections` now calls a new `translateFormSectionEntries` for each named section. The rules are the section rules, one level down: only copy the entry authors is translated, a missing key keeps the authored string, and an entry string that diverged from the packaged section's entry with the same `field` keeps its value (ADR-0029 D9.2a, through the existing `packagedPart` + `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, no second comparison). No address: a section without a `name`, a bare field-name entry, and a composite entry's sub-`fields`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` (`domain:server` rider, scaffold only): `walkObjectSections` emits the key for every entry string a form view's named section authors, from the same three form-view anchors the heading walk reads (`view.sections`, `form.sections`, `formViews.*.sections`), in the `section` bucket. `i18n-coverage.ts` needs no hunk: coverage is computed from that same walker, so `os i18n check` / `os lint` see the keys with no other change (pinned).
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`: the `_sections` facts gain each form-view section's entry `field`s, and `translation-target-unknown` reports a `_sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD` key no form-view section of that name declares as an entry object. `validate-translatable-sections.ts` is unchanged (see Acceptance notes).
- `packages/rest/src/public-form-section-i18n.test.ts` (`domain:server` rider, one door pin): `GET /forms/:slug` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` serves the translated entry label, placeholder and helpText when the pack has them, and the authored copy when it has none or under `en`.

## Tests (real readings, head 37a9e0fe)

- `packages/spec`: full `--project local` suite in three chunks: `src/system` 56 files / 1948 tests; `src/ui` and the root files 187 / 6603; every other directory 429 / 12167 (+1 todo). All passed. That includes `i18n-resolver.form-sections.test.ts` (new block: one pin per key, `label`, `placeholder` and `helpText`, beside the existing section pins; also missing key, authored-only, nameless section, explicit override vs packaged base, entry added after the fact, no input mutation) and `translation.test.ts` (accepts the node; strict; `help` goes to `helpText`).
- `packages/lint`: full suite 158 files / 7238 tests passed (new case: an entry key that resolves is accepted; a key under a `fieldGroups` section and one for a bare field-name entry are reported as `error`).
- `packages/cli` (unit tier, narrowed): every unit test file that imports the extractor or coverage module, 33 files / 384 tests passed, including the new `test/i18n-form-section-entry-coverage.test.ts` and the named `i18n-form-title-coverage` and `i18n-bulk-action-coverage`. The full unit tier needs more than the container's foreground cap; the integration tier is CI's.
- `packages/rest`: the five `translateView`-reaching suites, 5 files / 128 tests passed (`public-form-section-i18n` 17, 3 of them new).
- `packages/metadata-protocol`: it calls `translateView` in `src/protocol.ts` but has no translation test of its own. Its read path is exercised by the rest suites above over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`.
- Typecheck: `spec`, `lint`, `cli` and `rest` exit 0.
- Ablation, run once on committed HEAD with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the entry overlay's guard `if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return entries;` was replaced with `if (entries !== undefined) return entries;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 5942acf6 to 1b8de47c). Result: 5 of 23 in `i18n-resolver.form-sections.test.ts` failed (the label, placeholder and helpText pins, authored-only, and override). Restored, blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite reads `src/`, so the ablation needed no rebuild.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 117 commands on this diff. Exit codes were captured before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran`: 117 accounted for, 116 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3). It needs the whole workspace built, which is CI's job.
- Run a second time after clearing a missing prerequisite, then exit 0:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its pinned fixture commit was absent from this shallow clone.
  - `check:skill-examples`: needed `@objectstack/client-react` rebuilt.
  - `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`: needed `@objectstack/cli` built.
  - `check:query-options-erasure`: a repo-wide eslint ratchet. It ran detached until it finished.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` flagged two stale artifacts. `--fix` regenerated exactly those two, and they are committed: `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` and the `system/` strictness-ledger count (377 to 378 sites, from the one new strict shape).

## Acceptance notes

- The resolver follows the section precedent for an inline locale map: an entry string authored as `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` is authored copy and takes the catalog when the pack has a key. Not measured: whether the console renders such a map on an entry today. The crash that blocked it in objectui is closed, but this session did not run the console.
- `validate-translatable-sections` still warns only about a nameless section that has a heading. A nameless section with no heading, whose entries author override copy, has no address and gets no warning. Left as is, because extending that rule is outside this card's ask.
- Sub-`fields` of a composite or repeater entry are not addressed. Their names are relative to the parent entry, so keying them under the section would collide.
